args.subject: Group Booking Enquiry - 10 People in June
args.body:
Dear City Hub Tokyo Team,

I am organising a group stay for 10 people in June and would like to enquire about availability. Could you please let me know which dates are available and share any group rates or booking conditions that apply?

Thank you, and I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
